jordan-sales: Hey team — CustX asked for a SIG pass-through. Can we do a quick tabletop scrub of the answers before we hand off to their vendor risk? Need to lock artifacts + who uploads.

maria-sec: Yep. I can review for control language and evidence mapping. Do we have a source-of-truth for each Q?

alex-eng: I put a first pass in Confluence last night: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sigs/custx (draft). It lists Q1, Q4, Q7, Q12, Q19, Q23 as the ones they flagged.

jordan-sales: Perfect. Can we map owners and exact artifact paths? CustX expects direct links.

maria-sec: Assigning owners here: Q1 (auth) -> alex-eng; Q4 (data residency) -> sam-ops; Q7 (crypto/KMS) -> maria-sec; Q12 (vuln mgmt) -> alex-eng; Q19 (access reviews) -> sam-ops; Q23 (3rd party pen test) -> sec team (maria-sec).

alex-eng: I can attach the config snips and architecture diagram. Uploading to s3 path: `s3://sig-exports/custx/2026-03-21/` — file names: `Q1-auth-diagram.pdf`, `Q12-vuln-scan-20260319.pdf`.

sam-ops: For Q4 residency: we should include the region policy and legal clause. I'll bundle `residency-matrix.csv` and a short statement: `We store production data in us-west-2 and eu-west-1; backups in eu-west-1 only for EU customers.` Uploading to same S3 path.

maria-sec: KMS notes for Q7: we use customer-managed keys for Private deployments; hosted uses Redwood-managed keys with monthly rotation. Need to confirm rotation cadence for CustX — they requested 30-day rotation proof. We rotate monthly but our rotation window is 30–35 days depending on ops. Is that ok?

jordan-sales: CustX legal insisted on "30 days or less". Can we provide a statement and rotation logs?

maria-sec: I can pull KMS key rotation logs. Will redact key ARNs and include timestamps. File `Q7-kms-rotation-log.csv` + a short narrative `Q7-kms-statement.txt`.

sec-bot: [automated] Reminder: Evidence must not contain plaintext secrets. Use redaction or sanitized exports.

# export
aws s3 cp arch-diagram.pdf s3://sig-exports/custx/2026-03-21/Q1-auth-diagram.pdf
```

sam-ops: For access reviews (Q19) I can include the last 2 quarterly review notes and the RBAC matrix export. Files: `Q19-access-reviews-2025Q4-2026Q1.pdf`, `rbac-matrix.csv`

maria-sec: On Q23 (pen test) — our last third-party pen test was 2025-11-15. We can include the exec summary. Legal says full report needs an NDA; CustX has an NDA in review. I'll attach `Q23-pen-test-summary.pdf` and note the full report availability upon NDA.

jordan-sales: Awesome. Two process questions: 1) who will actually upload to the secure portal they provided? 2) Do we want to zip and checksum the package? They asked for SHA256.

alex-eng: I can upload to their portal if we want one uploader. I'll also generate SHA256 for each file. Example: `sha256sum Q12-vuln-scan-20260319.pdf > Q12-vuln-scan.sha256`

maria-sec: Prefer upload via our S3 + presigned links to avoid manual portal creds. But CustX insisted on portal for legal reasons. Jordan — can you confirm which they prefer (portal vs presigned links)?

jordan-sales: I'm asking CustX now — timeline: they want evidence by EOD Friday. If they insist on portal, alex can use a dedicated upload account we provisioned.

sec-bot: [automated] Checklist: Q1 diagram, Q4 residency, Q7 KMS logs, Q12 vuln scan, Q19 access reviews, Q23 pen test summary. All attachments must include SHA256.

alex-eng: I'll finish uploads + generate checksums. ETA 4pm PT tomorrow.

maria-sec: I'll review the narrative answers for control phrasing (least-privilege, separation of duties) and sign off. If I find any "we plan to" language, I'll flag for stronger wording.

sam-ops: FYI, on the residency matrix I added a note about backups retention and encryption-at-rest details. File `residency-matrix.csv` includes column `encrypted_at_rest = true`.

maria-sec: I have `log-retention-policy-2025.pdf` — I'll include it.

jordan-sales: Great — let's reconvene after uploads. If we hit NDA gating for the pen test, I'll escalate legal. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:

maria-sec: Sounds good. Ping me once uploads are done and I'll do a final pass.

alex-eng: Uploaded initial set to `s3://sig-exports/custx/2026-03-21/` and created presigned links. Sending links to Jordan via DM. Checksums attached.
